incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected for /generate on model-service-prod. 5xx spike and tokenization errors increasing since 12:04 UTC. Severity: P2. Link: https://console.redwood/ops/alerts/3071234567 :rotating_light:

maya (oncall): seeing the same on dashboards — latency + error % up. Canary region eu-west-1 is hit hardest.

sahil: what changed in last deploy? any release notes?

jess: deploy-bot reports last release at 12:00 UTC - artifact tag model-v3.2.1-weighted. rollout policy: canary 10% -> 100% (in progress).

eli (ml): quick check: weightset checksum for v3.2.1 != expected. tokenizer metadata also differs: vocab_size changed from 50257 -> 40960. That explains tokenization mismatches in logs.

maya (oncall): that would cause badly tokenized inputs -> weird outputs and model errors. Are canaries still running?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused automatically at 12:05 UTC due to error threshold. Current traffic: 9% routed to v3.2.1.

jess: can we flip the kill-switch flag for that model? featureflag-team exposed quick toggle `models.rollout.allow_v3_2_1` in prod.

sahil: I'm on it. `rkctl feature flip models.rollout.allow_v3_2_1 false --env prod`

ops-sre: verify before flipping: how many customer requests impacted?

laura (cs): we've received 3 customer tickets about odd completions (gibberish) and 1 enterprise noted hallucinations that look like tokenization artifacts. Customer-visible error is small but quality is degraded.

eli (ml): log snippet from problem requests (anonymized):
```
ERR token_decoder: invalid token id sequence [40960, 40961, 12, ...]
WARN tokenizer: unknown token 40960, falling back to <unk>
```
This matches vocab drift. weights themselves load but kv cache misalignment throws sequence errors downstream.

maya (oncall): ok flip then rollback plan. Steps: 1) flip flag to stop further canary traffic 2) force rollback to v3.2.0 in canaries 3) run quick health check on 10k requests 4) coordinate CS message.

sahil: flag flipped — `models.rollout.allow_v3_2_1=false` — confirmed in audit logs at 12:08:12 UTC. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Traffic routing reverted: canary traffic to v3.2.1 set to 0% at 12:08:20 UTC.

jess: initiating rollback to v3.2.0 canary: `deployctl promote --model model-service --from v3.2.0 --to canary --region eu-west-1`

deploy-bot: Rollback started, estimated 2 minutes.

ops-sre: monitor key SLOs: 95th latency, error-rate, tokenizer-exceptions metric. I'm watching K8s pod logs for crash loops.

eli (ml): also trigger a quick rehash of tokenizer config in prod: `tokenizerctl apply --model model-service --config stable-v3-tokenizer` to ensure vocab matches.

jess: rollback completed at 12:10:05 UTC. Canary now serving v3.2.0. Initial health checks: 200/200 requests returned and tokenization errors dropped to baseline.

maya (oncall): rolling forward health summary: error rate back to baseline in eu-west-1, global error % down 78% from peak. Latency stable.

laura (cs): sending holding note to affected customers: "We've identified a bad model rollout causing tokenization issues and noisy outputs. We've stopped the rollout and fully rolled back the canary. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause."

eli (ml): preliminary RCA: artifact build pipeline accidentally packaged weight bundle from an experimental branch (weights/name: exp-tokenizer-compat) while using the stable tokenizer config. The mismatch slipped past our pre-release checksum gate because the checksum used was for the bundle manifest but not the contained weight blobs.

sahil: adding immediate mitigations: 1) rollback 2) disable auto-promote until manual sign-off 3) tighten artifact verification to include blob-level checksums 4) add tokenizer-vocab-size assert during canary smoke.

maya (oncall): handoff to morning SRE and ML oncall for postmortem and follow-ups. I will create incident ticket INC-3071234567 and assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml.

jess: created INC-3071234567 — includes links to audit logs, failed canary traces, and CS notes.

ops-sre: recommend adding a temporary probe: compare tokenizer vocab hash between model artifact and deployed tokenizer at start of rollout. If mismatch -> abort. Will open PR to rollout-service.

eli (ml): I'll prepare patch for artifact pipeline to include blob checksums and owner signoff gating.

laura (cs): customers notified. No escalations to enterprise contacts yet; flagged for follow-up call if they request.

maya (oncall): any outstanding action items before I handoff?

sahil: monitor for any residual degraded completions for next 30m, keep rollback pinned to v3.2.0, and block any new v3.2.1 promotions until follow-up.

maya (oncall): thanks everyone. Handoff to eli and ops-sre for RCA and remediation. I'll close the pager but mark incident as on-hold until postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PAGER RESOLVED: 12:18 UTC — forward to postmortem workflow INC-3071234567. Severity reduced to P3.

eli (ml): note for postmortem: include sample malformed outputs, exact blob checksum diff, and the CI gate failure that was missing. Also propose a canary preflight job that runs tokenizer round-trip tests on a small corpus.

ops-sre: will follow up with a fast patch to rollout-service and open urgent PR.

laura (cs): I'll prepare customer follow-up template and loop in account owners for the small set impacted.

jess: leaving audit logs and deploy traces in the ticket. Closing thread after handoff complete.
